items.name: Brindle Twig
items.description: A branch that refused to break.

items.name: Gatekeeper's Shiv
items.description: Taken from the West Gate armory.

items.name: Umbral Fang
items.description: Bites the hand that holds it, gently.

items.name: Nihilos Edge
items.description: A piece of the ECHO, tamed.

items.name: Pulse Rod
items.description: The first spell ever cast left a mark.

items.name: Ashcloak
items.description: Woven from cooled ash. Fire resist.

items.name: Pale Parka
items.description: Warm as a held hand. Ice resist.

items.name: Crown Aegis
items.description: Worn by no one, until you.

items.name: Outcast's Wraps
items.description: Hide the face, keep the eyes.

items.name: Pebble of Origin
items.description: XP +5 percent. A rock from where you started.

items.name: Astrid's Ribbon
items.description: STR +2 below half HP. She believes in you.

items.name: Mira's Fuse
items.description: MAG +2 below half MP. Sparks fly.

items.name: Echo Locket
items.description: 10 percent chance to repeat a spell free.

items.name: Heartwood Seed
items.description: Revive once per battle at 25 percent HP.

items.name: Outcast's Token
items.description: Shops give 15 percent discount. One of us.

items.name: Memory Vial
items.description: Store one echo. Release it for a free battle turn.

items.name: Reef Tonic
items.description: Restore 35 HP. Tastes like low tide.

items.name: Gloomcap Tea
items.description: Cure all status, DEF +2 for 3 turns.

items.name: Starshard
items.description: Restore full HP. One use, one sky.

items.name: Beacon Flare
items.description: Call COSMOS instantly, max bond for 3 turns.

items.name: Crown Apple
items.description: Permanent max HP +2. Crisp. Three exist.

items.name: The Last Supper
items.description: Full restore and revive. For the road ahead.

items.name: Signal Core
items.description: Crafting material. Twelve total near rifts.

items.name: Memory Echo
items.description: Carried echo of the departed. Eight total.

items.name: Heartwood Sigil
items.description: Proof of the grove's trial. Opens deep Heartwood.

items.name: Outcast's Map
items.description: Reveals all hidden caches on the world map.

items.name: Arin's Journal
items.description: Records campaign progress. Opens the quest menu.

characters.name: ASTRID
characters.description: Swordmaster. Blunt, loyal, afraid of still water. Astrid's Oath.

characters.name: MIRA
characters.description: Engineer and beaconwright. Talks to machines like people. Repair the Beacon.

characters.name: BRINDLE ELDER
characters.description: Grove keeper and tutorial guide. Remembers every name. Find the Elder.

characters.name: CORVUS THE FENCE
characters.description: Merchant, ex-smuggler. Prices drop as trust rises.

characters.name: SABLE
characters.description: Outcast scout. Knows every hidden path. The Outcast's Road.

characters.name: TIDE PRIEST ILYA
characters.description: Reads the drowned spires. Speaks in tide metaphors.

characters.name: DIVER KESS
characters.description: Salvage diver. Sells Reef maps. Lost a brother to the deep.

characters.name: THE DROWNED CHOIR
characters.description: Echoes of drowned sailors. Give warnings as songs.

characters.name: EMBER WRIGHT HALVOR
characters.description: Smith. Forges Cinder gear. Burns his failures as offerings.

characters.name: ASH CHILD PIM
characters.description: Orphan guide. Knows safe paths through ash. Collects cool rocks.

characters.name: THE LAST VOLCANO
characters.description: Ancient entity. Advice once per visit: always true, always costly.

characters.name: THORN MOTHER
characters.description: Verdance guardian. Tests your gentleness. Fails the cruel.

characters.name: RANGER DUARTE
characters.description: Beast tracker. Teaches taming. Lost his beast, still tracks.

characters.name: THE QUIET APIARIST
characters.description: Beekeeper hermit. Sells poultices. Has not spoken in years; writes notes.

characters.name: FROSTBITE JUNA
characters.description: Ice fisher. Her laugh cracks thin ice.

characters.name: THE CARTOGRAPHER'S GHOST
characters.description: Maps the Pale Expanse from memory. Fades a little each visit.

characters.name: PALE ABBESS
characters.description: Heals free. Asks only that you remember her name.

characters.name: SCRAP BARON VEX
characters.description: Merchant lord. Controls Rust markets. Respects only builders.

characters.name: UNIT 7 (SEVEN)
characters.description: Retired machine. Chose a name over a number. Wants to see the sky.

characters.name: THE TINKER'S WIDOW
characters.description: Teaches advanced crafting. Keeps her husband's tools oiled.

characters.name: GLOAM GUIDE
characters.description: Blind navigator. Leads through Umbral Deep. Sees by listening.

characters.name: THE CONFESSOR
characters.description: Echo priest. Hears your regrets. Grants absolution buffs.

characters.name: MOTH KEEPER
characters.description: Beast handler. Raises gloom moths. Sells light in the dark.

characters.name: THE HOLLOW SAINT
characters.description: Fallen hero. Warns against the Deep's bargain. Was once a king.

characters.name: CROWN SENESCHAL
characters.description: Throne keeper and final gatekeeper. Polite, immovable, sad.

characters.name: THE STAR CHILD
characters.description: Mysterious youth before the final boss. Knows your name unasked.

characters.name: ECHO OF THE SON
characters.description: A small echo at story beats. Says little. Means everything.

characters.name: THE BUILDER'S SHADE
characters.description: The pieces are old. The assembly is yours.

characters.name: PRAYER KEEPER
characters.description: Postgame, all beacons lit. If everyone's happy, nobody prays.

characters.name: THE FIRST OUTCAST
characters.description: The one Eridoria cast out first. The road's true beginning.

characters.name: Brindle Sprout
characters.description: Tutorial mob. More scared than you.

characters.name: Gate Rat
characters.description: Steals 1 credit on hit.

characters.name: Reef Nipper
characters.description: Aquatic. Faster in water tiles.

characters.name: Drowned Husk
characters.description: May drop a Memory Echo fragment.

characters.name: Spire Jelly
characters.description: Splits into two when killed by fire.

characters.name: Ash Imp
characters.description: Leaves burn tiles.

characters.name: Cinder Hound
characters.description: Howls raise ally ATK.

characters.name: Slag Golem
characters.description: Slow. High DEF.

characters.name: Thorn Lurker
characters.description: Ambushes from plant tiles.

characters.name: Canopy Ape
characters.description: Throws fruit, ranged.

characters.name: Root Tangler
characters.description: Roots the player 1 turn on hit.

characters.name: Frost Mite
characters.description: Weak, swarms in threes.

characters.name: Pale Wolf
characters.description: Hunts in pairs.

characters.name: Glacial Wisp
characters.description: MAG attacker. Drops Pale Melt.

characters.name: Scrap Spider
characters.description: Drops Gear Tooth.

characters.name: Rust Hound
characters.description: Corrodes armor, temporary DEF -1.

characters.name: Dead Battery
characters.description: Explodes at 25 percent HP.

characters.name: Gloom Bat
characters.description: Blinds on crit.

characters.name: Umbral Crawler
characters.description: Invisible until it attacks.

characters.name: Sorrow Moth
characters.description: Drains 2 MP per hit.

characters.name: Crown Initiate
characters.description: Fights with ceremony. Bows first.

characters.name: Throne Wisp
characters.description: Pure MAG. No mercy.

characters.name: Gate Deserter
characters.description: Human enemy. May surrender to TALK.

characters.name: Reef Eel
characters.description: Electric. Stuns 10 percent.

characters.name: Barnacle Brute
characters.description: Tank. Drops Reefglass.

characters.name: Magma Tick
characters.description: Latches and drains HP 3 per turn.

characters.name: Obsidian Shardling
characters.description: Reflects 10 percent physical damage.

characters.name: Spore Mother
characters.description: Spawns 2 Sprouts at half HP.

characters.name: Vine Whipper
characters.description: High crit.

characters.name: Avalanche Cub
characters.description: Charges every third turn.

characters.name: Permafrost Knight
characters.description: Guards secrets.

characters.name: Cogling
characters.description: Repairs other machines mid-battle.

characters.name: Furnace Hound
characters.description: Fire aura, 2 HP per turn.

characters.name: Gloom Stalker
characters.description: Targets COSMOS first.

characters.name: The Forgotten
characters.description: Takes the shape of an NPC.

characters.name: Crown Lancer
characters.description: Always charges turn 1.

characters.name: Brindle Boar
characters.description: Charges below half HP.

characters.name: Tide Lurker
characters.description: Drags the player 1 tile on hit.

characters.name: Ember Sprite
characters.description: Dies in one hit. Hits like a truck.

characters.name: Mossback
characters.description: Sleeps unless provoked.

characters.name: THE GATE TYRANT
characters.description: Enrages when guards die.

characters.name: DROWNED CAPTAIN
characters.description: Summons 2 Husks at 50 percent.

characters.name: SPIRE MOTHER
characters.description: Spawns Jellies each turn.

characters.name: CINDER ALPHA
characters.description: Howl buffs the pack.

characters.name: THE SLAG KING
characters.description: Immune to fire. Slow.

characters.name: THORN REGENT
characters.description: Roots the entire party.

characters.name: CANOPY TYRANT
characters.description: Drops from above turn 1.

characters.name: THE WHITEOUT
characters.description: Blinds all for 2 turns at 50 percent.

characters.name: PERMAFROST JARL
characters.description: Shields allies.

characters.name: SCRAP COLOSSUS
characters.description: Repairs 10 HP per turn.

characters.name: THE FOREMAN
characters.description: Commands Coglings.

characters.name: GLOOM MATRIARCH
characters.description: Spawns Bats.

characters.name: THE CONFESSED
characters.description: Copies the player's last spell.

characters.name: CROWN CHAMPION
characters.description: Duels honorably. No adds.

characters.name: THE SENESCHAL'S SHADOW
characters.description: Counters magic.

characters.name: ECHO OF MALAKAR
characters.description: Postgame. A memory that fights back.

characters.name: THE TIDE CALLER
characters.description: Floods the arena.

characters.name: ASHEN PROPHET
characters.description: Marks the player's next move.

characters.name: THE QUIET ONE
characters.description: Silences magic for 3 turns.

characters.name: RUST SAINT
characters.description: Heals itself with Scrap Oil.

characters.name: MALAKAR, THE HOLLOW KING
characters.description: Two phases. Shatters the arena at 50 percent.

characters.name: NIHILOS ECHO
characters.description: Copies the party. The fight is a mirror.

characters.name: THE DROWNED GOD
characters.description: Floods the arena in phases. Kill the tide, not the god.

characters.name: CINDER MAW
characters.description: Eats the floor. Standing still burns.

characters.name: THE THORN HEART
characters.description: Heal it and it grows stronger. Starve it.

characters.name: THE PALE KING
characters.description: Freezes time at 33 percent. Skips player turns.

characters.name: THE MERIDIAN CORE
characters.description: Rebuilds adds. Destroy the forges first.

characters.name: VESPER, THE EVENING STAR
characters.description: Falls as she fights. Beauty as a weapon.

characters.name: THE CROWN ITSELF
characters.description: The throne is alive. It has been waiting.

characters.name: THE QUIET
characters.description: True final, postgame. The silence between signals. Bring echoes.

skills.name: Comfort
skills.description: Full cleanse and 25 HP, one ally.

skills.name: Home Signal
skills.description: Teleport to the last beacon, field.

skills.name: Stay
skills.description: COSMOS stays by your side. Always.

skills.name: Second Wind
skills.description: Survive lethal damage at 1 HP once per battle.

skills.name: Spellsword

skills.name: Battlemage
skills.description: Blade damage +10 percent with a staff.

skills.name: Prayer Answered
skills.description: 5 percent chance to fully heal on kill.

skills.name: The Assembly
skills.description: All stats +1 per crafted item, max +5.

skills.name: HEARTWOOD'S ANSWER
skills.description: Nature. The grove fights with you.

skills.name: THE VERDANT MAW
skills.description: Nature. Devours one ordinary enemy whole.

skills.name: PALE ETERNITY
skills.description: Ice. Freeze all enemies for 2 turns.

skills.name: MALAKAR'S END
skills.description: Finish what the Hollow King started.

skills.name: THE BUILDER
skills.description: Fully repair party and heal all 100 HP.

skills.name: OUTCAST'S STAND
skills.description: Cannot fall below 1 HP for 3 turns.

skills.name: MEMORY LANE
skills.description: Summon 3 echoes to fight for 3 turns.

skills.name: STAY WITH ME
skills.description: ARIN and COSMOS combine. Once per game day.

skills.description: Show mob locations on the map.
